tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The size of the iso-electronic species <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math> , Ar and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> is affected by:

options.text: azimuthal quantum number of valence shell
electron –electron interaction in the outer orbitals
Principal quantum number of valence shell

solution.text:
For isoelectronic species the size is compared by nuclear charge.
Size of isoelectronic species is compared on the basis of their nuclear charge.
